segments.sn22.121:1.4: Katame ca, bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā, katamaṃ upādānaṃ?
segments.sn22.121:1.5: Rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, upādāniyo dhammo, yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
segments.sn22.121:1.7: Vedanā … pe … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ upādāniyo dhammo;
segments.sn22.121:1.11: yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ.
segments.sn22.121:1.12: Ime vuccanti, bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā, idaṃ upādānan”ti.
